speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS), currently managed with oral contraceptive pills. Social history: Has recently joined a volleyball team.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Medial Tibial Stress Syndrome (Shin Splints).

Your history of recent intense volleyball, the specific pain location on the medial tibia, and the absence of a fracture on the scan confirm this diagnosis. The use of oral contraceptives and PCOS may contribute to bone density issues, but the clinical picture points to overuse injury. I recommend rest, ice, and activity modification to resolve the symptoms.
